name: unknown-field-root
description: A field the schema does not define is an error, not a silent pass-through.

name: unknown-field-node
description: Nodes are closed objects too.

name: unknown-field-value-object
description: Value objects such as a position are closed objects too.

name: custom-html-capabilities
description: Schema 0.1 defines no Custom HTML capability, so a document cannot grant one.

name: schema-version-older
description: The version before this one is refused at the gate, never upgraded by the validator: a host migrates it explicitly (D35.3, D42.9).

name: schema-version-unsupported
description: A version this build does not support yields one error instead of a flood of structural ones.

name: lifetime-start-missing
description: Every node has a lifetime; there is no default (D16.1, D42.1).

name: lifetime-duration-missing-on-background
description: The background has a lifetime like every node (D42.1).

name: lifetime-missing-on-group-child
description: A child of a group has a lifetime of its own (D42.1).

name: lifetime-duration-zero
description: A lifetime lasts at least one microsecond: a node that is never active by its duration does not exist (D42.1).

name: lifetime-start-negative
description: A lifetime begins at a composition time, which is never negative (D04, D42.1).

name: lifetime-start-fractional
description: A lifetime is in integer microseconds (D04).

name: lifetime-duration-above-safe-integer
description: A duration is a safe integer on its own; no rule concerns its sum with the start (D42.1).

name: schema-version-not-a-string
description: Any value other than a supported version string is an unsupported version.

name: schema-version-missing
description: The schema version is part of the document.

name: time-fractional
description: D04: persistent time values are integer microseconds.

name: time-negative
description: Time values start at zero.

name: time-not-a-number
description: A numeric string is not a time value.

name: time-above-safe-integer
description: 2^53 is the first integer that is no longer exact in every JSON implementation.

name: duration-zero
description: A duration is at least one microsecond.

name: fps-fractional
description: D13: the frame rate is an integer.

name: fps-out-of-range
description: D13: schema 0.1 accepts 1 to 120 frames per second.

name: canvas-too-large
description: D15: the canvas stops at 1920 because D07 stops at 1080p.

name: pixel-fractional
description: D15: persisted coordinates are integer composition pixels.

name: opacity-out-of-range
description: D15: opacity lies between 0 and 1.

name: color-uppercase
description: D15: colours are lowercase #rrggbb strings.

name: content-hash-unsupported-algorithm
description: D14: schema 0.1 accepts sha256 content hashes only.

name: asset-reference-unresolved-image
description: A missing required asset is an error, not a silent fallback.

name: asset-reference-unresolved-font
description: A font is an asset like any other.

name: asset-reference-unresolved-clip
description: Clips refer to assets as well.

name: asset-removed
description: Removing an asset reports every reference to it, in document order.

name: asset-reference-wrong-type
description: An image node cannot display a font.

name: duplicate-id-same-kind
description: The later occurrence of an ID is reported.

name: duplicate-id-across-kinds
description: D16: IDs share one namespace, whatever the kind of entity.

name: duplicate-id-animation
description: Animation IDs take part in the same namespace.

name: missing-id-scene
description: Scenes require a stable ID.

name: missing-id-node
description: Nodes require a stable ID.

name: missing-id-child-node
description: Nodes inside a group require a stable ID.

name: missing-id-clip
description: Clips require a stable ID.

name: missing-id-animation
description: Animations require a stable ID.

name: missing-id-asset
description: Assets require a stable ID. Structural errors stop validation before references are checked.

name: id-invalid-characters
description: D16: IDs match ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$.

name: node-type-unknown
description: An unsupported node type is one error at the discriminator, not one error per known type.

name: node-type-missing
description: A node without a type cannot be validated further.

name: group-nested
description: D16: groups do not nest in schema 0.1.

name: scene-second-without-duration
description: From 0.5 a composition may hold several scenes (D54.1), each with its own durationUs and clips, and from 0.6 its transitions (D56.1).

name: clips-several
description: D52.1: any number of clips; the second is checked like the first.

name: clip-source-start-missing
description: A clip states where its source starts; there is no default (D49.1, D52.1).

name: clip-source-time-out-of-range
description: Every source time of a clip's lifetime is a safe integer (D52.3).

name: clip-volume-above-one
description: A volume never amplifies (D52.2).

name: clip-fade-negative
description: A fade is a non-negative integer duration (D52.1).

name: clip-fade-fractional
description: Fades are integer microseconds (D04, D52.1).

name: clip-fades-exceed-duration
description: The two fades of a clip fit in its lifetime together (D52.3).

name: interpolation-removed
description: D67: 0.12 has no interpolation; each keyframe states its easing.

name: easing-missing
description: D67: every keyframe states its easing, the last one included; there is no default.

name: easing-kind-unknown
description: D67: spring and elastic curves are not easings of the schema.

name: easing-bezier-time-out-of-range
description: D67: x1 and x2 lie from 0 to 1, so that the curve is a function of time.

name: easing-bezier-value-out-of-range
description: D67: y1 and y2 lie from -1 to 2.

name: easing-steps-count-zero
description: D67: steps make 1 to 1000 jumps.

name: easing-steps-position-unknown
description: D67: a step comes at the start or at the end of its interval.

name: easing-named-with-parameters
description: D67: a named curve has no control points.

name: animation-property-unknown
description: D68: skew is not a property an animation can reach.

name: animation-value-wrong-shape
description: The keyframe value type follows the animated property.

name: keyframes-single
description: D16: an animation has at least two keyframes; a constant belongs on the node.

name: keyframes-not-ascending
description: D16: keyframe times ascend strictly, so array order carries no extra meaning.

name: animation-duplicate-target
description: D16: a node has at most one animation per property.

name: fit-missing-on-image
description: Every image states its fit; there is no default (D16.1, D50.1).

name: fit-unknown
description: Fit is one of fill, contain, and cover (D50.1).

name: focus-missing-on-image
description: Every image states its focus; there is no default (D16.1, D63.1).

name: focus-above-range
description: A coordinate of a focus is at most 1000 per mille (D63.1).

name: focus-negative
description: A coordinate of a focus is at least 0 per mille (D63.1).

name: focus-fractional
description: A coordinate of a focus is an integer number of per mille (D15, D63.1).

name: focus-unknown-field
description: A focus is a closed object of x and y (D63.1).

name: video-focus-missing
description: Every video states its focus too; there is no default (D63.1).

name: video-source-start-missing
description: A video node states where its source starts; there is no default (D49.1, D50.1).

name: video-unknown-field
description: A video node is a closed object: there is no muted, a volume of 0 is silence (D52.2).

name: video-asset-type-mismatch
description: A video node refers to an asset of type video, never to an image (D14, D50.1).

name: video-source-time-out-of-range
description: Every source time of a video node's lifetime is a safe integer (D50.2).

name: video-volume-above-one
description: The volume of a video never amplifies (D52.2).

name: video-in-group-unknown-fit
description: A video may be the child of a group, and its fit is checked there too (D50.1).

name: scenes-shorter-than-composition
description: The composition's durationUs must be the sum of its scenes' durationUs (D49.3, D54.2).

name: scene-second-not-counted
description: A second scene lengthens the composition, whose durationUs must say so (D54.2).

name: scene-duration-zero
description: A scene lasts at least one microsecond (D54.1).

name: scene-clip-unresolved-asset
description: A clip of a scene refers to an audio asset, as a composition clip does (D54.1).

name: scene-clip-fades-exceed-duration
description: The fades of a scene's clip fit in its lifetime (D52.3, D54.1).

name: scene-clip-unknown-field
description: A clip of a scene has exactly the fields of a clip (D54.1).

name: scene-transition-unresolved-scene
description: A scene transition names scenes of the composition (D56.3).

name: scene-transition-not-adjacent
description: The incoming scene directly follows the outgoing one (D56.3).

name: scene-transition-longer-than-scene
description: A scene transition lasts at most as long as either scene (D49.4, D56.3).

name: scene-transition-duplicate
description: A boundary carries at most one transition (D49.4, D56.3).

name: scene-transition-not-subtracted
description: The composition is shorter than its scenes by the duration of each scene transition (D56.2).

name: scene-transition-unknown-kind
description: A scene transition's effect is one of the closed set of kinds (D56.1).

name: scene-transition-slide-without-direction
description: A slide states its direction (D56.1).

name: scene-transition-color-uppercase
description: The colour of a fade through a colour is a lowercase #rrggbb (D56.1).

name: scene-transition-duplicate-id
description: A transition's ID lives in the one namespace of the document (D16.3, D56.1).

name: clip-transition-unresolved-node
description: A clip transition names nodes of its own scene (D56.3).

name: clip-transition-background
description: A background takes no clip transition (D56.3).

name: clip-transition-not-siblings
description: The two nodes of a clip transition are children of one parent (D49.2, D56.3).

name: clip-transition-overlap-mismatch
description: The two lifetimes overlap by exactly the transition's duration (D49.4, D56.3).

name: clip-transition-zoom-scale-out-of-range
description: A zoom starts at a factor from 0 to 16 (D66).

name: clip-transition-iris-center-out-of-range
description: The centre of an iris lies in the frame, in per mille from 0 to 1000 (D66).

name: clip-transition-push-without-direction
description: A push states its direction (D66).

name: clip-transition-easing-missing
description: A transition states its easing; there is no default (D67).

name: clip-transition-easing-steps-fraction
description: The count of steps is an integer (D67).

name: clip-transition-duplicate
description: A clip meets at most one transition at each of its ends (D49.4, D56.3).

name: clip-transitions-longer-than-clip
description: The two transitions of one clip together last at most as long as it (D49.4, D56.3).

name: caption-words-overlap
description: A word of a captions node starts no earlier than the word before it ends (D57).

name: caption-words-out-of-order
description: The words of a captions node are in the order they are spoken (D57).

name: caption-font-not-a-font
description: A captions node names a font asset, as a text node does (D14, D57).

name: caption-word-with-space
description: A word holds no white space: the runtime joins words with one space (D57).

name: caption-word-empty
description: A word has at least one character (D57).

name: caption-max-lines-zero
description: A page holds at least one line (D57).

name: template-missing
description: A composition of 0.8 has a template section, empty when it is no template (D58.5).

name: template-input-type-unknown
description: The input types are closed (D58.1).

name: template-boolean-default-text
description: The default of a boolean input is a JSON boolean, not a text (D58.1).

name: template-text-lengths-contradict
description: A text input's maxLength is at least its minLength (D58.1).

name: template-text-default-too-long
description: The default of a text input meets its constraints, in code points (D58.1).

name: template-number-default-out-of-range
description: The default of a number input lies within its bounds (D58.1).

name: template-list-duplicate-key
description: The fields of a list have distinct keys (D58.1).

name: template-list-item-wrong-field
description: An item of a list default holds the value of each field at its place (D58.1).

name: template-list-too-few-items
description: A list default has at least minItems items (D58.1).

name: template-input-id-taken
description: An input's ID shares the one namespace of the document (D16, D58.1).

name: binding-input-unresolved
description: A binding names an input of the template (D58.2).

name: binding-node-unresolved
description: A binding names a node of the composition (D58.2).

name: binding-property-not-on-node
description: An image has no bindable colour (D58.2).

name: binding-input-wrong-type
description: The text of a node takes a text input, not a colour (D58.2).

name: binding-value-not-default
description: A bound property holds the default of its input (D58.3).

name: binding-target-twice
description: The text of a node takes one binding: its whole text, or its placeholders (D58.2).

name: placeholder-unclosed
description: Every {{ of a bound text begins a placeholder {{inputId}} (D58.2).

name: placeholder-input-unresolved
description: A placeholder names an input of the template (D58.2).

name: placeholder-input-boolean
description: A placeholder takes a text or number input (D58.2).

name: placeholders-on-image
description: Only the text of a text node holds placeholders (D58.2).

name: asset-binding-wrong-type
description: An asset takes an input of its own type (D58.2).

name: asset-binding-unresolved
description: A binding names an asset of the composition (D58.2).

name: asset-binding-not-default
description: A bound asset holds the default of its input as its content hash (D58.3).

name: binding-kind-unknown
description: The kinds of binding are closed (D58.2).

name: template-conditions-missing
description: A template of 0.9 has a list of conditions, empty when it has none (D59.5).

name: template-repeats-missing
description: A template of 0.9 has a list of repeats, empty when it has none (D59.5).

name: condition-test-unknown
description: A condition tests with one of a closed set of predicates (D59.1).

name: condition-target-unresolved
description: A condition names a scene or a node of the composition (D59.1).

name: condition-input-unresolved
description: A condition tests an input of the template (D59.1).

name: condition-test-type-mismatch
description: A test fits the type of its input: true reads a boolean (D59.1).

name: condition-equal-number-on-text
description: equal-number reads a number input (D59.1).

name: repeat-duration-unknown
description: A repeat takes the duration of its target or of a field (D59.2).

name: repeat-target-unresolved
description: A repeat names a scene or a node of the composition (D59.2).

name: repeat-input-not-list
description: A repeat reads a list input (D59.2).

name: repeat-field-unresolved
description: A repeat takes its duration from a field of its list (D59.2).

name: repeat-field-not-number
description: A duration is read from a number field (D59.2).

name: repeat-nested
description: No repeated node lies inside a repeated scene (D59.2).

name: repeat-twice
description: A target is repeated by one repeat at most (D59.2).

name: repeat-in-transition
description: A repeated node is no side of a clip transition, whose overlap its copies could not keep (D59.2).

name: repeat-id-reserved
description: No ID has the form of the ID of a copy of an ID a repeat copies (D59.2).

name: item-property-outside-repeat
description: An item binding lies inside a repeat over its list (D59.3).

name: item-placeholder-outside-repeat
description: A placeholder of a field lies inside a repeat over its list (D59.3).

name: item-placeholder-field-unresolved
description: A placeholder of a field names a field of its list (D59.3).

name: item-placeholder-too-deep
description: A placeholder is {{inputId}} or {{inputId.key}}, nothing deeper (D59.3).

name: item-property-field-unresolved
description: An item binding names a field of its list (D59.3).

name: item-property-not-list
description: An item binding reads a list input (D59.3).

name: item-asset-field-type-mismatch
description: An asset takes a field of its type (D59.3).

name: item-asset-outside-repeat
description: Every use of an asset bound to a field lies inside one repeat over its list (D59.3).

name: rotation-out-of-range
description: D68: a rotation lies from -360000 to 360000 degrees.

name: origin-fraction
description: D68: an origin is an integer in per mille of the box.

name: origin-out-of-range
description: D68: an origin lies from 0 to 1000 per mille of the box.

name: crop-out-of-range
description: D68: a crop inset lies from 0 to 1000 per mille.

name: crop-empty
description: D68: two opposite insets that leave nothing of the picture are refused.

name: crop-keyframe-empty
description: D68: a crop keyframe leaves a picture too.

name: corner-radius-fraction
description: D68: a corner radius is whole composition pixels.

name: animation-size-on-text
description: D68: only an image or a video animates its size.

name: animation-color-on-group
description: D68: a group has no colour to animate.

name: animation-opacity-on-background
description: D68: a background animates its colour only.

name: animation-color-uppercase
description: D68: a colour keyframe is lowercase #rrggbb, as every colour of the schema.

name: bound-property-animated
description: D68: a colour that an animation replaces at every instant cannot be bound.

name: text-style-missing
description: D69: every text has a style, plain or not.

name: text-stroke-width-zero
description: D69: a stroke is at least one pixel wide; no stroke is kind none.

name: text-shadow-opacity-above-one
description: D69: the opacity of a shadow is a factor from 0 to 1.

name: text-box-kind-unknown
description: D69: a box is none or solid.

name: text-animation-unit-unknown
description: D69: a fragment is a letter, a word, or a line.

name: text-animation-tracks-empty
description: D69: a text animation has at least one track.

name: text-animation-track-twice
description: D69: a text animation has at most one track per property.

name: text-animation-keyframes-not-ascending
description: D69: the keyframes of a track ascend strictly, as those of an animation.

name: text-animation-seed-too-large
description: D69: the seed of a random order is an unsigned 32-bit integer.

name: text-animation-accent-negative
description: D69: an accent starts at a scene time, from 0.

name: text-animation-id-taken
description: D69: a text animation has an ID of its own, unused in the document.

name: text-animation-color-uppercase
description: D69: a colour keyframe of a track is lowercase #rrggbb.

name: text-animations-on-background
description: D69: only a text has text animations.

name: bound-color-of-color-track
description: D69: a colour that a colour track replaces for every fragment cannot be bound.
